Eddie Alley was born in Minneapolis, Minnesota on December 19, 1910. His family moved to San Francisco while Eddie was a young man and the name Alley is now synonymous with music in the Bay Area. Throughout his life, Eddie played a role in the jazz and popular music scene as a drummer, band leader and musical contractor. He counts numerous jazz legends as friends and former bandmates.
Eddie was interviewed in San Francisco, California on August 8, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive. His daughter was present at the interview and participated briefly.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in San Francisco and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and I know I’m going to enjoy talking to veteran drummer Eddie Alley. It’s very nice to have you here.
And I just learned that you are 91 years young.
You know when I came into town and I started talking to different people, guys at the musician’s union, and the name Alley came up right away, right away.
So it’s nice to have you here.
